title: Clean-machine, migration, soak, and release verification audit
audit_scope_note: Static read-only audit of repository evidence at base 42718fbc plus coordination commit 039dcfa7. Statuses classify the strongest existing machine-verifiable evidence per release surface. No installers were executed, no accounts touched, no ports bound.

status_legend.proven: a committed, runnable gate exercises this surface today and is wired into an enforced acceptance path
status_legend.partial: some committed evidence exists but it is not wired into a release-enforcing gate or has documented platform/scope gaps
status_legend.missing: no committed artifact provides this release proof; named successor packets own closing the gap
status_legend.owner_only: surface is deliberately absent from worker-reachable scope and requires owner action (signing/notarization/distribution/account)
status_legend.external: proof depends on infrastructure outside this repository

negative_control.claim_examined: docs/deployment.md's update recipe (git pull; npm ci; npm run build; pm2 restart) makes upgrading a live production server safe.
negative_control.why_unsupported: No clean-machine or migration artifact backs this claim: there is no save-migration matrix (a snapshot written by a different schemaVersion hard-fails restore per native/src/core.cpp and the browser SQLite stores have no versioned migration path either), no rollback procedure exists anywhere in the repository, and no clean-machine harness reproduces the update on a pristine host. The claim silently assumes data compatibility across versions.
negative_control.discharge_path: TASK-0127 save-migration matrix + TASK-0126 clean-machine release harness (both sequenced after this audit) must produce those artifacts before the upgrade claim may be treated as release proof.
